scope: One bounded recorded guided respiratory-mechanics lesson using these exact native and projected artifacts. Not disease, physiological, clinical or learner validation.

playback.method: Select named original fields and remove repeated JSON keys; preserve every row and value exactly. Historical comparison checked all native CSV rows and complete-breath summaries. Full native lesson-data.json is not included.

verification.repeatAndRestore: Both perturbations repeat and continue from active checkpoints exactly across exported numeric and discrete channels; not byte-identical full state/action JSON.

reviewedNuances: Restore fills omitted mechanics modifiers with source-defined identity values of 1 via Activate. Only those defaults are allowed; submitted interventions and effective parameters are unchanged.
Initial incomplete breath was excluded by a regression-fixed boundary detector; old summaries and failed checks remain preserved. No raw recording or numerical tolerance changed.
Direct native Current circuit access supplies actual R and C witnesses, not public bilateral compliance getters.
Both perturbations reduce sampled breath-volume span but not equally; no parameter tuning or volume matching was performed.
Low compliance also reduces resting volume. Diagram must retain this change rather than independently normalizing each branch to appear identical at rest.

Breathing input-volume uses driver_cmH2O, not absolute musclePressure_cmH2O. Same-side alveolar-minus-pleural pressure may be paired with same-side alveolar volume. Neither dynamic trajectory is a static-compliance test or diagnostic template.
Playback and authored comparison are not live branching or engine state restoration.
